config.theme: Branding image: two kids coding together at a laptop, reimagined as a warm 1940s golden-age comic panel. Headline "FUN FRIENDS IN A FUTURE", a kid's speech balloon about coding being fun and building real skills, and a large League of Amazing Programmers wordmark in the lower right.
config.scene_description: Two happy kids side by side at a laptop, coding together. In the foreground an East Asian girl with straight black hair in a ponytail, wearing a bright magenta-pink long-sleeve top, leans in and points at the glowing laptop screen; beside her a boy in a blue plaid/checked shirt watches intently, chin resting on his hand. Warm, focused, joyful collaboration; code glows on the laptop screen facing them.

iterations.prompt:
A WIDE LANDSCAPE 4x6 postcard — a clean flat-colored comic-book poster (1940s Golden-Age spirit: bold hand-inked black outlines and large flat solid color areas) with COMPLETELY SMOOTH, TEXTURE-FREE coloring — every fill is one uniform solid color like modern digital flat coloring or vector art. NO grain, noise, speckle, dithering, film grain, paper texture, halftone, or Ben-Day dots anywhere; nothing aged or weathered. Freshly-printed, glassy-clean. Everything inset with a clear border margin on all four edges — nothing bleeds off any edge.

WIDE LAYOUT in three horizontal bands:
- TOP BAND (upper ~22%): plain golden-amber background carrying the HEADLINE on ONE arching line of bold outlined curved comic display lettering, centered, with clear empty golden space above AND to the left/right so no letters touch any edge. It reads EXACTLY: FUN, FRIENDS AND A FUTURE  (keep the comma; do not repeat or add any word).
- MIDDLE BAND (center ~58%, the wide main scene): two happy kids side by side at a laptop, coding together, warm three-quarter angle (follow the attached PHOTO reference for their poses). In the foreground an EAST ASIAN girl with straight black hair in a ponytail, wearing a bright magenta-pink long-sleeve top, leans in and points one finger at the glowing laptop screen. Beside her a boy in a blue plaid shirt watches intently, chin on his hand. The laptop faces us enough to show code glowing on the screen. The kids are the richly-inked heroes with proud, focused, expressive faces; the warm classroom behind them simplifies into bold flat shapes. The wide format gives room on both sides of the pair.
- BOTTOM BAND (lower ~20%): on the LEFT a cream comic speech balloon (tail pointing to the girl) reading EXACTLY "Coding is SO much FUN — and we're building real skills for our future!"; on the RIGHT the League wordmark badge, its whole shape and all three text lines fully inside the frame with margin around it.

COLOR — warm orange-and-blue complementary palette (~70% warm / 30% cool): golden-amber and marigold fields, burnt-orange and sienna warm shadows, steel-blue and deep-navy cool accents on edges and deepest shadows, ink-black linework, cream balloon fills, girl's top vivid magenta-pink. Vivid printed-comic color. Shadows are flat hard-edged black shapes — no gradients, no soft shading — every fill perfectly smooth.

LOGO detail: reproduce the attached black-and-white LOGO reference faithfully — a curved double-outline banner with EXACTLY THREE stacked text lines and NOTHING more: (1) "THE LEAGUE OF", (2) large "AMAZING", (3) "PROGRAMMERS", with small lightning bolts flanking. The word "OF" appears only ONCE, at the end of line 1 — do NOT add any separate standalone "OF" line above AMAZING. Recolor to the orange-blue treatment (cream/gold lettering, steel-blue banner, black keylines); every letter crisp and correct.

Render ONLY the headline, the one speech balloon, and the logo as text — no other posters, signs, slogans, labels, or lettering; code only on the laptop screen. Optimistic, cheerful, aspirational.
iterations.negative_prompt: Square or vertical format (must be wide landscape), headline clipped or touching any edge, oversized headline, logo or balloon clipped, full-bleed with no border, elements bleeding off any edge. Duplicated or repeated words, a second standalone "OF" line in the logo, a "THE LEAGUE OF / OF / AMAZING" stack. TEXTURE OF ANY KIND, grain, noise, speckle, stipple, dithering, film grain, paper/canvas texture, halftone, Ben-Day dots, cross-hatching. Aged, weathered, distressed, yellowed, foxed, crumbling paper. Photorealism, painterly, airbrush, soft gradients, soft/blended shading, 3D, CGI. Faded, muddy, washed-out color. Non-Asian girl. Photorealistic identifiable faces. Cool gray shadows. Extra invented text, wall text, or code anywhere except the laptop screen. Misspelled or garbled logo lettering. Frightened or menacing mood.
